item.title: Roblox Survival Horror Game 'You vs. Homer' Goes Viral, Gaining Thousands Of Players And Inspiring Memes
item.description: You vs. Homer is a Roblox survival horror game by deerxsx and RetroStudio based on The Simpsons where one player, as Homer Simpson, must hunt down several other players or "Barts" hiding around the map. The game, which includes several modes like "Classic" and "Infection," was released in mid-October 2025 and garnered a significant fanbase by January 2026, resulting in viral clips and memes based on the game, including the "Homer Ritual" meme. item.title: 'City Boy' Meme Featuring 'Gravity Falls' Clip Sees New Resurgence Online
item.description: City Boy! City Boy! refers to a scene from the animated TV show Gravity Falls in which the character Deputy Durland mockingly yells, "City boy! City boy!" at Dipper, mocking him. item.title: A Mother's Inside Joke About 'Chili Mac' Becomes A Lip Dub Meme On TikTok
item.description: Chili Mac or Chilli Mac is a lip dub audio meme based on a viral video of TikToker @girl.idk393 recording herself while her mother talks on the phone in the background, exclaiming, "chili mac!" and laughing. The video was posted in late December 2025 and became the subject of lip dubs over the following weeks, in which the exclamation "chili mac!" is often used to represent an inside joke between friends.

item.title: Trump Interrupts Oil Exec Meeting To Look At His Ballroom, Inspiring Green Screen Memes
item.description: Donald Trump Looking Out Window at Ballroom or What a View is an exploitable green screen meme format based on a video of U.S. President Donald Trump pausing a meeting with oil executives to look out a set of windows on a door at the White House's ballroom addition, exclaiming, "What a view." As a meme, the windows are replaced with something funny that Trump is meant to be looking at with wonder.
